categories.name: ~ Contemporary UK Jazz & Modern Fusion
categories.rationale: Captures the current wave of modern jazz, acoustic-electronic crossover, and spiritual groove-driven jazz coming primarily out of London, Bristol, and Chicago.
examples: Blacked Out by Yussef Dayes, Alfa Mist
You Can't Steal My Joy by Ezra Collective

categories.name: ~ Modal, Avant-Garde & Classic Jazz
categories.rationale: Dedicated to the masters of bebop, hard bop, modal jazz, and radical avant-garde/free-jazz improvisations.
examples: Arab And Jew by John Zorn

categories.name: ~ Deep Dubstep & 140 UK Bass
categories.rationale: Heavy sub-bass vibrations, half-step rhythms, sound system dubplates, and dark atmospheric 140 BPM soundscapes.

categories.name: ~ Grime, UK Drill & British Rap
categories.rationale: Fast-paced UK flow, grime MCing, drill baselines, and gritty street poetry from the British rap landscape.
examples: BLESSED (feat. Dizzee Rascal) by Ocean Wisdom

categories.name: ~ IDM, Glitch & Experimental Electronics
categories.rationale: Intricate beat patterns, brain-dance melodies, complex synthesis, and acoustic-digital manipulation.

categories.name: ~ Minimal Techno & Microhouse
categories.rationale: Long-form, subtle, hypnotizing club tracks featuring stripped-back kick drums, micro-samples, and deep dance floor grooves.
examples: Que bel epoque 2006 by Ricardo Villalobos
Burn with Me (Victoria Edit) by DJ Koze
Time For Us by Nicolás Jaar

categories.name: ~ Organic House & Folktronica
categories.rationale: Warm, emotive, atmospheric dance music incorporating field recordings, acoustic instruments, and lush synth pads.
examples: Reflections - Mojave Desert Continuous Mix by Floating Points

categories.name: ~ Industrial Techno & Darkwave
categories.rationale: Aggressive synth basslines, driving mechanical beats, electro-clash energy, and dark club textures.
examples: Decade of Agression by Arnaud Rebotini

categories.name: ~ Modern Classical & Neo-Classical
categories.rationale: Acoustic piano explorations, subtle string arrangements, ambient textures, and minimalist modern compositions.
examples: Right Right Right (Paris) by Nils Frahm

categories.name: ~ Post-Rock, Math Rock & Alternative
categories.rationale: Dynamic, crescendo-building instrumental rock, angular math-rock guitar riffs, and atmospheric alt-rock.
examples: We Drift Like Worried Fire by Godspeed You Black Emperor!

categories.name: ~ Afrobeat, Highlife & Afro-Jazz
categories.rationale: Driving brass horn sections, interlocking guitar grooves, polyrhythmic drumming, and African funk/soul heritage.
examples: Afrodisco Beat by Tony Allen With Africa 70
Brothers On The Slide by Cymande

categories.name: ~ Global Bass & Organic Downtempo
categories.rationale: Electronic fusion blending Indigenous South American, Middle Eastern, and North African instrumentation with slow electronic beats.

categories.name: ~ Roots Reggae & Dub System
categories.rationale: Classic Jamaican roots reggae, studio dub echo-chamber experiments, and dub poetry sound system classics.
examples: I Chase the Devil by Max Romeo, The Upsetters
Pass The Dutchie by Musical Youth
Orderliness, Godliness, Discipline And Dignity by African Head Charge

categories.name: ~ US Hip-Hop & Abstract Rap
categories.rationale: West Coast classics, Golden Era boom-bap, experimental US rap, and lyric-driven hip-hop.
examples: m.A.A.d city (feat. MC Eiht) by Kendrick Lamar
either on or off the drugs by JPEGMAFIA

categories.name: ~ Chanson Française & French Pop
categories.rationale: French-language lyricism, classical chanson, French hip-hop, and indie-synth pop.
examples: Le Plat Pays by Jacques Brel
Nés sous la même étoile by IAM
Paradis Perdus by Christine and the Queens

categories.name: ~ Art Pop, Folk & Singer-Songwriter
categories.rationale: Vocal-led indie pop, acoustic folk, soul-infused ballads, and art-pop arrangements.
examples: Fistful Of Love by Antony and the Johnsons, ANOHNI
